title: Sharp width-dependent Turán conjecture for convex domains
statement:
Let $K\Subset\mathbb C$ be a compact convex domain. Denote by $d$ its diameter and by $w$ its width, let $n\in\mathbb N$, and let $\mathcal P_n(K)$ denote the relevant class of polynomials of degree at most $n$ on $K$. For $q\ge 1$, write $\|\cdot\|_{L^q(\partial K)}$ for the boundary $L^q$ norm.

**Width-dependent Turán conjecture.** There exists an absolute constant $c>0$ such that, for every compact convex domain $K\Subset\mathbb C$ and every $p\in\mathcal P_n(K)$,

$$
\|p'\|_{L^q(\partial K)}\ge c\frac{w}{d^2}n\|p\|_{L^q(\partial K)}.
$$

This would sharpen the conjectured linear lower bound by identifying the geometric dependence through the width-to-diameter-squared ratio. The supplied passage presents it as a further sharpening motivated by the maximum-norm result and constructions giving matching order, but it does not establish the claim.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1805.04822

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of May 2018).
source_name: Polina Yu. Glazyrina and Szilárd Gy. Révész, “Turán-Erőd type converse Markov inequalities on general convex domains of the plane in L^q”, arXiv:1805.04822 (2018).
